turns.text: Hello! How can I help you today?
How do I create an e-mail signature?
Hold on a second while I look that up.

Open a new message, go to Message > Signature > Signatures, then on the E-mail Signature tab click New and name it.
Enter and format your signature, add items like a business card, hyperlink, or picture if needed, then click OK. Are you satisfied with the agent's response?
